quote.text:
So make the switch today!

Get lifetime access to Switchy.io now!

claims.text: Customize, manage and track retargeting links to boost conversions

quote.text: Switchy.io lets you customize, manage, and track retargeting links so you can boost conversions.

claims.text: Customize the appearance of a shared post on social networks

quote.text: You have the ability to customize the appearance of a shared post on social networks.

claims.text: Edit link title, domain, description and image

quote.text: Edit the title, domain, description, and image so your links shine.

claims.text: 30+ advanced options including retargeting pixels, UTMs, tags, geo-redirect and A/B testing

quote.text: From there, you can add retargeting pixels, UTMs, tags, geo-redirect, A/B testing, or even activate deep links using 30+ advanced options to help your conversions skyrocket.

claims.text: Integrate retargeting pixels directly into links without technical skills

quote.text: You can integrate retargeting pixels directly into your links without any technical skills thanks to step-by-step instructions.

claims.text: Every user who clicks link will be automatically pixeled and targeted on any ads platform

quote.text: So now every user who clicks your link will be automatically pixeled and targeted on any Ads Platform.

claims.text: Smart deep links from 150+ integrated platforms

quote.text: Plus, you can drive your users to the highest-converting channels with smart deep links from +150 integrated platforms, letting you steer your audience to specific pages on every platform or device.

claims.text: Mini-landing pages designed for mobile for use as biolink

quote.text: These mini-landing pages are designed for mobile, so you can use them as a more comprehensive biolink for your social profiles to redirect leads to your most important content.

claims.text: Smartpage builder offers over 100 templates and 20 block types

quote.text: The easy-to-use smartpage builder offers over 100 templates and 20 different block types to fit with any type of industry, whether you’re a DJ, social media marketer, or online retailer.

claims.text: Detailed metrics and analytics for each link including clicks, devices, referrals and sources

quote.text: Dive deep with detailed metrics and analytics for each link, like click numbers, device types, referrals, audience sources, and more!

claims.text: Run A/B tests and smart ads for campaigns

quote.text: You’ll also be able to run A/B tests and smart ads for more efficient campaigns!

trials.claimQuote:
So make the switch today!

Get lifetime access to Switchy.io now!
trials.reasoning: A buyer reports buying Switchy six years ago and using it ever since, supporting long-term access; the prosecution exhibits are speculative or about development pace, not loss of lifetime access.

exhibits.quote: It's also possible that my account was deleted and I cannot use my codes again.
exhibits.argument: This shows lifetime access can be lost if the account is deleted.

exhibits.quote: The product feels more maintained than actively developed.
exhibits.argument: This undermines lifetime value because the product is not actively developed.

exhibits.quote: I bought Switchy six years ago and have been using it across campaigns ever since.
exhibits.argument: Six years of continuous use confirms long-term lifetime access is honored.

trials.claim: 30+ advanced options including retargeting pixels, UTMs, tags, geo-redirect and A/B testing
trials.claimQuote: From there, you can add retargeting pixels, UTMs, tags, geo-redirect, A/B testing, or even activate deep links using 30+ advanced options to help your conversions skyrocket.
trials.reasoning: Two buyers confirm UTMs, retargeting pixels, redirect logic, tagging, tracking and many other options; the prosecution complaints concern multiple users or isolated redirect failures, not the absence of the listed options.

exhibits.quote: Bought it in 2022 and it's lacking features that other link shorteners have now such as multiple users
exhibits.argument: This shows the tool lacks advanced targeting features claimed as part of the 30+ options.

exhibits.quote: Firefox redirections don't work neither iPhone ones for some links and there's no way to redirect those users.
exhibits.argument: This shows redirect functionality fails for some browsers and devices.

exhibits.quote: Custom domains, UTMs, retargeting pixels, and redirect logic mean you can control how links behave
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms UTMs, retargeting pixels and redirect logic work as promised.

exhibits.quote: From organizing links, to branding links, tagging, Pixels, tracking, UTC, GA, smartpages, QR codes, shareable reports, a massive library of integrations, team feature, and more...
exhibits.argument: Buyer lists many advanced options including tagging, pixels and integrations confirming breadth of features.

trials.claim: Smart deep links from 150+ integrated platforms
trials.claimQuote: Plus, you can drive your users to the highest-converting channels with smart deep links from +150 integrated platforms, letting you steer your audience to specific pages on every platform or device.
trials.reasoning: The exhibits show one missing platform and some device redirect failures, but provide no evidence about whether 150+ platforms are actually integrated, and no defense exhibit confirms that count.

exhibits.quote: No way to add bluesky, it's just not there and the font awesome integration is so old
exhibits.argument: This shows integrations are outdated and missing platforms, undermining the 150+ platforms claim.

exhibits.quote: Firefox redirections don't work neither iPhone ones for some links and there's no way to redirect those users.
exhibits.argument: This contradicts steering audience to specific pages on every platform or device.

trials.claim: Customize, manage and track retargeting links to boost conversions
trials.claimQuote: Switchy.io lets you customize, manage, and track retargeting links so you can boost conversions.
trials.reasoning: Reviews say retargeting tracking lacks the insights needed to judge performance and that links cannot be readily identified in the dashboard, materially limiting the claimed manage-and-track benefit.

exhibits.quote: Without these insights, users may struggle to fully understand a retargeting campaign performance and make informed decisions to improve ROI.
exhibits.argument: This shows tracking lacks depth needed to understand retargeting performance and boost conversions.

exhibits.quote: there's no easy way to identify which short link belongs to which person as you can’t see the full URL unless you copy and paste it somewhere else.
exhibits.argument: This shows managing many tracking links is impractical because URLs cannot be viewed from the dashboard.

exhibits.quote: Discover Switchy, the easiest retargeting url shortner. Get more from your links and boost your conversion rate!
exhibits.argument: Vendor's own page states it is a retargeting shortener that boosts conversion rate.

exhibits.quote: The customization options are great for engaging my audience.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms customization options help engage audience and boost business.

trials.claim: Customize the appearance of a shared post on social networks
trials.claimQuote: You have the ability to customize the appearance of a shared post on social networks.
trials.reasoning: Buyers report custom images are limited to a Facebook format and customized appearance failed to appear on WhatsApp, contradicting customization across social networks.

exhibits.quote: I tried to create some links when I noticed I could only create images in a format suitable for Facebook only (horizontal rectangle).
exhibits.argument: This shows image customization is limited to one Facebook format, not all social networks.

exhibits.quote: No me sirvió, intente varias veces que el personalizado aparezca en WhatsApp y no.
exhibits.argument: This reports customized appearance failed to appear in WhatsApp shares.

exhibits.quote: I tried to create some links when I noticed I could only create images in a format suitable for Facebook only (horizontal rectangle).
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the tool lets you create custom images sized for Facebook sharing.

trials.claim: Edit link title, domain, description and image
trials.claimQuote: Edit the title, domain, description, and image so your links shine.
trials.reasoning: Image editing is restricted to one Facebook-sized format and edited customization reportedly did not display on WhatsApp; the defense only confirms custom domains, not the full title, description and image editing claim.

exhibits.quote: I tried to create some links when I noticed I could only create images in a format suitable for Facebook only (horizontal rectangle).
exhibits.argument: This shows editing the image is restricted to a single size unsuitable for other platforms.

exhibits.quote: No me sirvió, intente varias veces que el personalizado aparezca en WhatsApp y no.
exhibits.argument: This reports edited custom title, description and image did not display as intended.

exhibits.quote: I can create as many pretty links with my domain (eg. go.mydomain.com) as I want and it works perfectly.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms custom domain link editing works perfectly.
